collision_and_write_policy.creation: Create draft first using exact unique tag, full workflow commit and deterministic marker containing config SHA256 plus manifest SHA256. Existing orphan tag is rejected.
collision_and_write_policy.draft_resume: Only exact tag/name/target/body/marker, same commit, and existing asset subset whose server digest/size/state all match. Absent tag may be resumed only for an exact matching draft because GitHub may create its tag at publication.
collision_and_write_policy.published_resume: Verify-only; require all13 existing assets. No upload or edit of an existing published release.
collision_and_write_policy.mutations: No delete, clobber, git commit, branch update, tag update or backup Release API. Only primary create draft, upload missing matching assets, and publish that draft.
collision_and_write_policy.public_verification: Unauthenticated whole HTTP200 download of every asset; exact complete size/full SHA256 and original bytes, plus ZIP CRC/internal bytes. Server digest must also equal expected full SHA256.
